@package unison-util-diff3
@version 0.0.0

module Unison.Util.Diff3
data Hunk a
Hunk :: [a] -> Hunk a
Conflict :: [a] -> [a] -> [a] -> Hunk a

-- | Produce a 3-way diff, given lca, alice, bob. The returned list of
--   hunks may have consecutive non-conflict hunks, but won't have
--   consecutive conflicts.
diff3 :: Eq a => [a] -> [a] -> [a] -> [Hunk a]
instance GHC.Internal.Show.Show a => GHC.Internal.Show.Show (Unison.Util.Diff3.Hunk a)
